description: Read daily asking rent history for either a city or a property. Supply exactly one of city or property_id. Changes in the tracked sample can affect market trends.

city.description: City slug returned by list_covered_cities, for example austin-tx. Resolve city names with list_covered_cities.

days.description: Number of past days to read, from 7 to 365. Defaults to 90 for a city and 180 for a property.

property_id.description: Property ID from search_apartments results. Use this positive integer to select one building.

name: get_rent_history
title: Read rent history
